720-1806-2034-6634.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
720-1806-2034-6634.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adidng {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Kinzu of the Bleak Coven and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Kinzu of the Bleak Coven trigger, causing you to pay 2 life and exile Eternal Scourge from your graveyard to create a token copy of it that is 1/1.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eternal Scourge token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Eternal Scourge token dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.

206-339-677-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
206-339-677-8227.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Loot by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2445-5231-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-792-2033-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-792-2033-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Totentanz triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

4247-4826-5222-6644.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Sword of the Realms trigger.
Resolve the Sword of the Realms trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that are untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{G}{G}{G}{W}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Realms by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Ancient Adamantoise.
Repeat.

2557-4826-6441-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

225-751-3314-5233.easyPrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You control a land that can tap to add {U}.
225-751-3314-5233.description:
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land you control.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying one mana.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it triggers itself and Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

5256-7084-7705.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Mole Man triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

643-4302-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
643-4302-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1796-1824-2530-7351.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1796-1824-2530-7351.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Prism Ring triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

240-997-4927-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat from step 2.

465-643-3742-4251-7060.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

215-1770-3390-3518-6865.description:
Cast Astelli Reclaimer for its warp cost by paying {2}{W}.
When Astelli Reclaimer enters, it triggers twice, returning Lion's Eye Diamond and Lotus Bloom from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Astelli Raclaimer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-1770-3390-3518-6865.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can continue the combo returning any noncreature, nonland permanents with mana value 5 or less. You should instead cast Astelli Reclaimer for its normal mana cost in this case.

1168-1651-4426-5542-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1168-1651-4426-5542-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1168-1651-4426-5542-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers twice due to Delney, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

1618-2365-6496--97.easyPrerequisites: You have a storm count of 1 if the self-suspending card is not in your hand, or a storm count of 0 otherwise.
1618-2365-6496--97.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Expropriate and the self-suspending card, if needed, during the first turn.
1618-2365-6496--97.description:
Cast the self-suspending card by paying its mana cost if its in your hand, or any other spell otherwise if you have not cast a spell this turn.
Cast Expropriate by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Expropriate and then exiling it with four time counters on it and giving it suspend.
Resolve the copy of Expropriate, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of that turn's upkeep, Expropriate and the self-suspending card's suspend abilities trigger, removing a time counter from each of them.
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing three time counters from Expropriate and the self-suspending card, triggering their suspend abilities.
Resolve the self-suspending card's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost, and eventually exile it with time counters on it.
Resolve the Expropriate's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.
1618-2365-6496--97.notes: It is highly recommended to choose a self-suspending card that you are certain will have legal targets, if applicable, every time it is cast.

1329-2178-3652-5686.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2178-3652-5686.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Ornithopter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2178-2438-2857.easyPrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Adarkar Valkyrie.
2178-2438-2857.notablePrerequisites: Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
2178-2438-2857.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Carrion Feeder.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Adarkar Valkyrie triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Adarkar Valkyrie.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Carrion Feeder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
2178-2438-2857.notes: You may instead target another nontoken creature you control to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Carrion Feeder.

2079-2933-4499-5798.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

147-1223-5147.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one creature on the battlefield.
147-1223-5147.description:
Cast Fake Your Own Death by paying {1}{B}, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Fake Your Own Death, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Fake Your Own Death.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield and creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Goblin Bombardment abilities, dealing that much damage to any target(s).

4690-4871-5003-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three basic lands.
4690-4871-5003-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Phylath.
When Phylath dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Phylath from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Phylath enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating at least three 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Activate Altar of Dementia three times by sacrificing three Plants.
When the Plants die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers three times, creating three Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia abilities from steps 1 and 7, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creatures' powers.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.
If you control at least four basic lands, this combo nets infinite Plant tokens, Treasure tokens and colored mana.

618-2438-2732.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Prowling Geistcatcher with haste.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki.
When Kiki-Jiki dies, the nontoken and token Prowling Geistcatcher's first abilities trigger.
Resolve the token Prowling Geistcatcher's trigger, exiling Kiki-Jiki from your graveyard.
Resolve the nontoken Prowling Geistcatcher's trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Prowling Geistcatcher token.
When the token Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability and the nontoken Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers.
Resolve the nontoken Prowling Geistcatcher trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the token Prowling Geistcatcher trigger, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Storm the Vault // Vault of Catlacan

568-1460-2026-2597-4618.notablePrerequisites:
Instill Energy attached to Voyaging Satyr.
Wild Growth attached to Vault of Catlacan.
You control at least six artifacts.
568-1460-2026-2597-4618.description:
Activate Vault of Catlacan's second ability by tapping it, adding six {U}.
Wild Growth triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Vault of Catlacan.
Activate Instill Energy by paying {0}, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Cast Capsize with buyback by paying {4}{U}{U}, returning Instill Energy from the battlefield to your hand, and then returning Capsize to your hand.
Cast Instill Energy by paying {G}, attaching it to Voyaging Satyr.
Repeat.
If you control seven or more artifacts, this combo nets infinite colored mana.

4486-4944.description:
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {0}.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Hold priority and repeat from step 1.
Resolve all Mirror Entity abilities.

575-4674-4786.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one green card in hand.
575-4674-4786.description:
Activate Claws of Gix by paying {1} and sacrificing Temur Charger.
When Temur Charger dies, Yedora triggers, returning Temur Charger to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Claws of Gix ability, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Temur Charger by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Temur Charger's morph ability by revealing a green card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

413-1734-4681.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 one additional time.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.

575-2034-4674.notablePrerequisites: You have a green card in hand.
575-2034-4674.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Temur Charger, adding {C}{C}.
When Temur Charger dies, Yedora triggers, returning Temur Charger from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Temur Charger by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Temur Charger's morph ability by revealing a green card from your hand, turning Temur Charger face up.
Temur Charger triggers, giving target creature trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

2060-4120-4498.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Vigor indestructible.
You have the highest life total.
2060-4120-4498.description:
Give Vigor indestructible by any method.
Activate Pestilence by paying {B}, dealing 1 damage to each creature you don't control, Vigor and each player, and putting a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control due to Vigor.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat from step 2.
